title: a repository whose index git cannot read: --version prints a bare commit over a dirty tree, fullcycle --dry-run dies with git's 128, check critic says nothing is staged, and the release pre-flight says its log directory is not ignored
body:
## Problem

A repository whose index git cannot read, such as one with a truncated or corrupt `.git/index`, still answers `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git tag --list`. Every call that reads the index (`status`, `diff --cached`, `ls-files`, `check-ignore`) fails at rc 128 with "fatal: .git/index: index file smaller than expected". Four readers take that failure for an answer:

1. `git_head_identity` (lib/helpers:2448) tests `git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null` for empty output, so a failed status reads as a clean tree. `--version` over a dirty tree prints the bare commit, with no `+dirty`, at rc 0: a provenance line naming a commit its bytes are not. `fullcycle`'s header prints the same bare `HEAD:` line.
2. `_fullcycle_header` (lib/cmd/fullcycle:469-471) then counts the dirty files. Its probe, `rev-parse --git-dir`, passes, and the count's `git status` fails into `wc` under pipefail, so `fullcycle --dry-run` exits 128 with git's fatal line and no devbin words. The comment above it names that hazard for a tree that is no checkout; 0185 adds the case of a checkout git cannot read, and its probe still passes here.
3. `builtin_check_critic` (lib/cmd/check:134) warns "nothing staged -- the critic will examine NO files, which is not a failure here" when `git diff --cached` fails, its stderr discarded and its status unread. Intent's critic then fails at rc 2, so the gate fails closed, under a diagnosis that is wrong. devbin's own `check critic` overrides the builtin with the whole corpus, so this reaches the projects that use the builtin.
4. The release pre-flight's `gate_out_ignored` (lib/runlog:1477-1484) asks `git check-ignore`, which fails, and then 0179's reading, which writes no ignore file where a `.git` is present. So a `tmp/release/` already carrying its own `*` ignore file, as 0157's writer leaves it, is refused as "not ignored ... -- add tmp/ to .gitignore", beside the refusal that names the cause, "git status failed: ...".

Found by critic-shell reviewing 0185 (cc, 2026-10-07). Each predates 0185, and 0185 does not change them. 0185's publish refusal already names a corrupt index through git's own line.

## Measured (vc, 2026-10-07, main 1a8665be, git 2.56.0)

A clone of main with `.git/index` cut to its first 20 bytes. Scratch: ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/0.1.10/idx, with idx-*.out and idx-fc/ beside it.

- git: `status --porcelain`, `diff --cached --name-only` and `ls-files` exit 128 with "fatal: .git/index: index file smaller than expected"; `rev-parse HEAD` and `tag --list` exit 0. Cut to 64 bytes instead, git 2.56.0 segfaults on the same three calls, rc 139.
- `--version`, with a tracked file edited: `devbin 0.1.9 (<sha>, runtime 289d1e4a0307)` at rc 0. With the index readable, the same tree prints `<sha> +dirty`, and clean it prints the bare sha with runtime a73927828f89.
- `fullcycle --dry-run`, in the suite's rust fixture with a commit: with the index readable, rc 0 and "dirty: 0 file(s)"; with it cut, `HEAD:  <sha>`, then git's fatal line, rc 128.
- `intent critic shell --staged`: rc 2, "error: `git diff --cached` failed". The builtin's own test, `[ -z "$(git -C ... diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null)" ]`, is true there, so it warns that nothing is staged first. This was driven as the builtin's command and Intent's call, not through a project using the builtin. A control with one staged file and the index readable examines 1 file at rc 0.
- `release --patch --dry-run`, in the clone with `tmp/` taken out of `.gitignore` and `tmp/release/.gitignore` reading `*`: step 2 FAILED with "git status failed: fatal: .git/index: index file smaller than expected" and "tmp/release/ is not ignored, and every gated run writes its log there -- add tmp/ to .gitignore". With the index readable the second is absent, and so it is with the index cut while `tmp/release/` does not exist yet. No run reached the gates.

## Fix

A failed git call is never an answer, and the reader that meets one says git could not read the tree, with git's own first line (0185's `git_failure_line`). `git_head_identity` gives the commit with a mark that says the tree's state could not be read, never the bare commit; `fullcycle`'s header reports a checkout git could not read, as 0185's header does for one git refuses, rather than dying in the count; `builtin_check_critic` says git could not say what is staged; and `gate_out_ignored`'s caller, the pre-flight, says git could not say whether its log directory is ignored, never "add tmp/ to .gitignore". Built on 0185, which adds `git_failure_line` and `git_repo_absent` and shares lib/helpers and fullcycle's header with it.

## Done when

1. Over an index git cannot read, `--version` never prints the bare commit: the identity says the tree's state could not be read. The arm cuts `.git/index` and is red on main first.
2. There, `fullcycle --dry-run` says so in devbin's words and never exits with git's raw status; `check critic`'s builtin says git could not say what is staged; and the release pre-flight says git could not say whether its log directory is ignored. Each is held by an arm red on main first.
3. With a readable index every line is as before, held by each arm's control, but one: where `git check-ignore` itself fails over a readable index, as it does on a `tmp/` committed as a link to a directory outside the tree ("beyond a symbolic link"), the release pre-flight says git could not say whether its log directory is ignored, with git's line, and never "add tmp/ to .gitignore", a remedy measured not to clear that refusal. An arm holds it, with a plain `tmp/` in the tree as its control.

When filed, Done when 3 said every line is as before with a readable index, with no exception. It names the one since vc's ruling of 2026-10-08 on cc's measurement: a failed check-ignore is a failed git call, which the Fix says is never an answer.

## Resolution

Landed at 48baceea on a green full suite (vc's, 2257 of 2257 ok, 0 not ok, .errors empty, seal 20261008-0811). A failed read of an index git cannot read is no longer an answer anywhere it was taken for one.

- **--version (Done when 1):** git_head_identity marks the commit `+unreadable` where git names it but cannot give the tree's status, never the bare sha.
- **fullcycle --dry-run (Done when 2):** it reads its status whole and its exit with it, so it succeeds and says "a checkout git could not read -- these bytes are not compared to anything -- <git's line>". A status that answers but warns prints the warning under the count.
- **check critic's builtin (Done when 2):** where its plain `git diff --cached` fails, it stops with "git could not say what is staged ... so the critic was not run -- <git's line>". That reason is asked of the index the probe read (git_failure_line --plain), so under a commit hook's GIT_INDEX_FILE it is that index's. In a project that is not a git checkout it stops, and says so. On main it read the failed `git diff --cached` there as nothing staged, warned that the critic would examine no files, and ran it, so with a critic that passes it exited 0.
- **The release pre-flight (Done when 2):** gate_out_ignored answers rc 2 where git could not say -- its check-ignore failed, or git could not be run at all. The pre-flight then says "git could not say whether tmp/release/ is ignored -- <git's line>", never "add tmp/ to .gitignore".

Each is held by an arm with a readable control (Done when 3). The arms were driven red on d51f1592: main's code with 0185 v2.1, which this change is built on.

0185 does not change how any of the four reads an index git cannot read, measured by a diff. Of the four readers, the one 0185 touches is fullcycle's header: its probe through git_readonly, and its third state. 0185 also changes _gate_out_ignore_file, the writer's rule the pre-flight's gate_out_ignored falls to, in its failed ls-files reading. git_head_identity, builtin_check_critic, gate_out_ignored and the pre-flight are byte-identical. The first build's seven arms give the same results, line for line once paths and shas are normalised, on main's code and on d51f1592.

Done when 3 holds for every readable-index line but one, where `git check-ignore` itself fails over a readable index, as on a tmp/ committed as a link to a directory outside the tree ("beyond a symbolic link"). There the pre-flight says git could not say, with git's line, where it offered "add tmp/ to .gitignore": that remedy was measured not to clear the refusal, since with tmp/ and tmp ignored and committed check-ignore still exits 128. An arm holds the exception, with a plain tmp/ as its control.

Declared, not built: both versions refuse a tmp/ linked out of the tree, though logs written through the link cannot dirty the tree. Whether the pre-flight should accept such a link is put to hv.

Held by 14 arms; 11 are red on d51f1592 and the other three are guards. 28 mutants, 28 killed.
